# Font Awesome Free 6.7.2, locally hosted

- `css/all.min.css`: byte-identical to `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.7.2/css/all.min.css`.
- `webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2` and `webfonts/fa-brands-400.woff2`: the two font files the site uses (`fa-solid` for 122 icon uses, `fa-brands` for WhatsApp, Instagram and LinkedIn).
- `webfonts/fa-regular-400.woff2` and `fa-v4compatibility.woff2` are not hosted because no page uses regular icons or the v4 class names. Those files are referenced by the CSS but only requested if such an icon is added. Add them here if that happens.
- `LICENSE.txt`: the Font Awesome Free license from the official 6.7.2 release. Icons are CC BY 4.0, fonts are SIL OFL 1.1, and CSS is MIT.

Attribution: the icons are licensed under CC BY 4.0, which requires credit to Font Awesome. Where that credit should appear is a legal decision and has not been added to any legal page.
